• presented findings to senior leadership and implemented top 3 recommendations

Process mapping and optimisation

• identified bottlenecks and proposed reengineering steps

ANALYTICAL SKILLS
• Data analysis: Python, Pandas, NumPy
• Visualisation: Tableau, Power BI
• Statistical analysis: Regression, hypothesis testing
• Database: SQL, Microsoft Access

PROFESSIONAL SKILLS
• Requirements elicitation and mapping
